parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must provide a report regarding the intimations given to affected data principals.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: A report must be provided regarding intimations given to affected data principals.
parsed_entries.applicability: When a data fiduciary has provided intimations to affected data principals.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is specific to the requirement of reporting intimations given to affected data principals.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must describe measures implemented or proposed to mitigate risk.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: A description of measures implemented or proposed to mitigate risk must be provided.
parsed_entries.applicability: When a data fiduciary has implemented or proposed measures to mitigate risk.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires a description of risk mitigation measures.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must describe other means, if any, using which such data principal may exercise rights.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: A description of other means, if any, using which a data principal may exercise rights must be provided.
parsed_entries.applicability: When a data principal may exercise rights through other means.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation covers the description of alternative means for data principals to exercise their rights.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must define the term 'designated authority' as an authority designated under section 15 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: The term 'designated authority' must be defined as an authority designated under section 15 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
parsed_entries.applicability: When the term 'designated authority' is used in the context of persons with disabilities.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires a specific definition of 'designated authority'.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must apply the provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and its rules to individuals with long-term impairments who are unable to take legally binding decisions.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: The provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and its rules must be applied to individuals with long-term impairments who are unable to take legally binding decisions.
parsed_entries.applicability: When dealing with individuals with long-term impairments who are unable to take legally binding decisions.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires the application of specific legal provisions to vulnerable individuals.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must apply the provisions of the National Trust Act, 1999 and its rules to individuals suffering from autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation, or severe multiple disabilities.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: The provisions of the National Trust Act, 1999 and its rules must be applied to individuals suffering from autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation, or severe multiple disabilities.
parsed_entries.applicability: When dealing with individuals suffering from specified disabilities.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires the application of specific legal provisions to individuals with specified disabilities.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must define the term 'local level committee' as a committee constituted under section 13 of the relevant Act.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: The term 'local level committee' must be defined as a committee constituted under section 13 of the relevant Act.
parsed_entries.applicability: When the term 'local level committee' is used in the context of persons with disabilities.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires a specific definition of 'local level committee'.
